verdict.rationale: Claude has explicit first-party memory/chat-search docs: it can search previous conversations and "remember context from your chats and carry it into new conversations and Cowork tasks," plus a dedicated article on how memory works, what's remembered, and how to review/edit it; the product page also advertises "Memory across conversations" as a core feature. This directly matches the story of remembering context across chats and applying it in new ones. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of memory quality or limitations in practice beyond vendor docs.
